scope: Actual modules in Node VM; choreography policy and presentation only, not canon certification.

checks.name: An intro starts and ends without storing combat state or commands
Pause freezes the clock and step advances exactly one integer tick
Intro speed is scaled after delta clamping, independent of monitor frequency
Invalid clock inputs never advance and excessive time is bounded
Skipping is idempotent and a restart resets every presentation field
All 346 subjects use the correct intro UID without advancing the true engine
Reduced motion freezes the artwork tick, not the deterministic intro duration
All existing finisher IDs have a defined noncanonical compatibility verdict
Humanlike compatible shapes retain the inherited prototype conclusion
Every conclusion rejects a projection as a victim
Aquatic, collective, plant, giant, winged and mechanical victims cannot use the generic fall
Unknown/reference gabarits fail closed instead of inheriting a human body
Cross-incarnation finisher IDs cannot select another fighter repertoire
A low body cannot enter the standing grapple sequence and size envelopes are respected
Policy evaluation never mutates profiles, life, resources or finishing history
Gameplay, art and isolated replay contracts remain byte-identical to R9
